messages:
Jae: hey folks, Jae here — first day! quick onboarding questions about org ownership so i know where to route things: 1) who owns model fallback rules (e.g., fallback to smaller quantized model when Dedicated is busy)? 2) who approves Dedicated console access and is there a standard request template? 3) who should be paged for increased inference error rates vs perf regressions? thanks! :wave:

Priya: welcome Jae :tada: Routing/fallback policy = eng-platform (they own routing + capacity policies). For access, file the access request form (IT workflow) and cc your manager. Page eng-sre oncall for production incidents.

Oscar: adding a little detail on paging: if it's infra/capacity -> eng-platform oncall, if it's runtime (OOMs, batching) -> eng-runtime. Model-specific quality issues -> eng-ml. If customers are impacted, add `#customer-impact` and loop in CS.

Marta: access template (paste into IT ticket):
```
Subject: Dedicated Console Access - jae@example.com
Requester: Jae (jae@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Role: Engineer
Environment: staging/prod
Reason: onboarding + need to validate routing/config for feature Y
Okta group: redwood-dedicated-users
Approver: <manager-email>
Notes: expected peak QPS 120
```

Access-bot: IT ticket created: #IT-4521. Approver: <manager-email> assigned.

Nina: extra tip — if you need temporary elevate for testing (24h), mention `temp-access: 24h` in the notes and include a rollback/cleanup plan. Also check /docs/ownership for the current owner list (keeps changing).

Jae: filed ticket and added manager, noted temp-access. Appreciate the quick help! DMing anyone if i run into permissions issues.
